no_action.description: Give only a verbal response and do not move the robot.

stand_up.description: Move from rest into a stable standing pose.

rest.description: Move into the low-power resting pose.

balance.description: Adopt the stable balanced standing pose.

walk_forward.description: Walk forward a short, safe demonstration distance.

walk_backward.description: Walk backward a short, safe demonstration distance.

turn_left.description: Turn left in place by a small demonstration amount.

turn_right.description: Turn right in place by a small demonstration amount.

wave.description: Perform a short friendly greeting gesture.

guard_mode.description: Enter desk-guard operating mode. This action must be returned alone.

play_mode.description: Enter playful companion operating mode. This action must be returned alone.
